_comment: One wallpaper site, described as data. name/search are required; everything else has a default. 'search' is the endpoint, 'params' the query string, where {query} is what he typed, {page} the page number and {<option>} the current value of an option below (a param whose expanded value comes out empty is left off the request, so an empty search box sends no q at all). 'list'/'page'/'last_page'/'total' are dotted paths into the reply; 'fields' says which path each column of a card comes from. Facts this file rests on, measured 2026-10-12 from this machine: GET /api/v1/search answers 200 with no key, X-RateLimit-Limit: 45 per minute, and https://wallhaven.cc/robots.txt is 'User-agent: * / Disallow:' with nothing after it. min_interval_ms is the local half of obeying that 45: a page of 24 cards is one request, and only 入库 asks the CDN for anything.
